description.en: AnimeRank is a Turkish anime streaming platform with Turkish subtitles and dubs, ad-free, up to 4K quality.
description.tr: AnimeRank; Türkçe altyazılı ve dublajlı, reklamsız, 4K'ya kadar kalitede anime izleme platformu.

settings.title: Privacy Mode
settings.description: Hides anime and episode information from your presence.

settings.title: Show Cover
settings.description: Shows the anime cover instead of the AnimeRank logo.

settings.title: Show Timestamp
settings.description: Shows elapsed and remaining time of the episode.

settings.title: Show Buttons
settings.description: Shows the 'Watch Episode' and 'View Anime' buttons.
